verdict.rationale: uv publishes an llms.txt index of its docs at docs.astral.sh/uv/llms.txt, served as text/plain, and every docs page can be fetched as raw markdown by appending index.md. That lets a user point an agent directly at agent-friendly docs. The probe 404s hit different paths (the domain-root /llms.txt and /uv/.md), so they do not contradict the documented locations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the /uv/llms.txt and index.md endpoints resolve, and any dedicated agent-usage guidance beyond the llms.txt index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
